title: TruckOpti Sellable Product Contract
why: Anchor TruckOpti's current launch claim on one accepted, repo-owned contract artifact for the sellable product slice instead of leaving the launch scope implied across long task history and checklist prose.

included: Public marketing, pricing, checkout, and auth shell served by the current frontend
Protected customer, agency, driver, and admin workflows already called out in the current launch checklist
Production configuration proof for subscriptions, auth, and payment readiness on the current sellable-product slice
excluded: Optional future auth variants such as re-enabled phone OTP
Deferred native Supabase PITR and backup upgrades beyond the currently accepted temporary backup posture
Future optimization or packing-quality work that is not required for the immediate sellable-product launch slice

validation.expectedGuardrail: TO-105 and TO-106 remain the active launch-proof slice, with TO-104 queued for normalized evidence capture once live checkout and stale-client proof land
